familyDescriptions.castoridae: Beavers - large semi-aquatic rodents and the animal world's most prolific engineers, felling trees and damming streams to create the wetland habitat they depend on.
familyDescriptions.caviidae: Guinea pigs, capybaras, and their South American relatives - the family includes the capybara, the largest living rodent, alongside much smaller cavies domesticated for food and companionship.
